title: Table levitation at family seances

tellings.quote: we actually had paranormal phenomenon we were kids
it a few times, like the table knocking
tellings.difference: Describes table knocking rather than levitation, with no time or place given.
tellings.link_reason: This is the same table phenomena from Levenda's early sessions that telling 7 describes.

plain: Around 1965 and 1966, during family seances in the Bronx, a table is said to have risen off the floor. The writer Peter Levenda tells Michels he saw it himself as a child: "we actually had paranormal phenomenon" when "we were kids." In another telling on the same show he describes the table knocking rather than lifting, and gives no time or place.
